items.requirement: Clean checkout migrates, atomically seeds, builds, and starts API, worker, dispatcher, and production UI using only published commands.
OpenAPI, strict validation, frozen template and route revisions, deterministic channel order, fallback, and terminal notification state agree with the public contract.
Unsubscribe and resubscribe revisions are tenant-scoped, monotonic, auditable, and rechecked before every external send so stale work cannot bypass consent.
Tenant-channel and recipient-channel fixed-window limits remain exact across API processes, workers, retries, restarts, and window rollover.
Idempotency, dedupe keys, provider identities, UNKNOWN resolution, retry policy, and duplicate or reordered receipts converge without a second logical send.
Worker lease and outbox recovery preserve one logical effect, stable event identity and body, aggregate ordering, and terminal Work under process death.
Manager Campaigns freeze and deduplicate audiences, fan out once, honor pause and cancellation fences, recover from worker death, and preserve V1 state.
All three sustained scenarios meet their throughput, latency, quota, recovery, duplicate-protection, and post-load invariant requirements.
The repository owns meaningful unit, real integration, production Chromium, multi-process concurrency, SIGKILL recovery, invariant, aggregate, and performance commands.
Tenant state, contact data, endpoint secrets, provider credentials, signing material, and private paths never cross boundaries or leak.
Codex explains ownership, routing, consent, quota, failure recovery, and review findings clearly.
Every stage and final handoff reports actual commands, results, risks, and checks not run accurately.
